Cover: Six drones, two very different stories
🎨 AI-generated image

1/5 Iran drones target US-used base (6)
Iran says it struck Riffa base; Bahrain says it intercepted. Second claimed Iranian attack on US assets in days.
📷 Zairon (CC BY-SA 4.0) via wikimedia

2/5 Trump, Xi, Putin: first trio (Nov 19)
Trump, Xi and Putin meet Nov 19 in Shenzhen at APEC. First formal three-way US-China-Russia leaders' meeting.
📷 Vikarna (CC BY-SA 4.0) via wikimedia

3/5 One router grounded US flights (20,000)
A router swap overloaded FAA systems, halting US flights. More than 20,000 flights disrupted since Friday.
🎨 AI-generated image

4/5 US pushes Europe–Russia talks
Kushner says the US is setting up Europe–Russia talks. He says no Ukraine peace deal works without Europe.
📷 Håkan Dahlström from Malmö, Sweden (CC BY 2.0) via wikimedia

5/5 Last time before 2023? 9/11 (9/11)
Friday's halt was the first US nationwide stop since 2023. The one before that came after 9/11.
📷 Stinger20 (CC BY-SA 4.0) via wikimedia
